exercises.name: Bodyweight Squat
exercises.cue: Feet hip-width apart, sit back like lowering into a chair, chest lifted.
exercises.formTip: Keep knees tracking over toes, don't let them cave inward.

exercises.name: Glute Bridge
exercises.cue: Lie on back, knees bent, feet flat. Squeeze glutes to lift hips.
exercises.formTip: Avoid arching the lower back — squeeze glutes, not just push up.

exercises.name: Wall Push-Up
exercises.cue: Hands on wall at shoulder height, step back, lower chest toward wall.
exercises.formTip: Keep body in a straight line, don't let hips sag.

exercises.name: Knee Push-Up
exercises.cue: Hands under shoulders, knees on mat, lower chest to floor.
exercises.formTip: Keep a straight line from head to knees, elbows at 45°.

exercises.name: Standard Push-Up
exercises.cue: Hands under shoulders, body in a plank, lower chest to floor.
exercises.formTip: Keep core braced so hips don't drop.

exercises.name: Bird Dog
exercises.cue: On all fours, extend opposite arm and leg, hold briefly, return.
exercises.formTip: Keep hips level — don't let them rotate open.

exercises.name: Dead Bug
exercises.cue: Lie on back, arms and knees up. Lower opposite arm and leg slowly, keeping back flat.
exercises.formTip: Exhale as you extend; don't let the lower back arch off the mat.

exercises.name: Standing Marching
exercises.cue: Stand tall, lift knees alternately to hip height in a slow march.
exercises.formTip: Keep pelvis stable, avoid tilting side to side.

exercises.name: Kegel Hold
exercises.cue: Gently lift and squeeze the pelvic floor muscles, hold, then fully release.
exercises.formTip: Breathe normally throughout — don't hold your breath or clench glutes/thighs.

exercises.name: Seated Pelvic Tilt
exercises.cue: Seated tall, gently rock pelvis forward and back, engaging deep core.
exercises.formTip: Keep the movement small and controlled.

exercises.name: Step-Up
exercises.cue: Step fully onto a step or low stair, drive through the heel, step down with control.
exercises.formTip: Avoid pushing off the back foot — let the front leg do the work.

exercises.name: Standing Side Leg Lift
exercises.cue: Holding onto a chair for balance, lift leg out to the side and lower slowly.
exercises.formTip: Keep torso upright, avoid leaning to compensate.

exercises.name: Seated Row (Band)
exercises.cue: Band anchored in front, pull elbows back, squeezing shoulder blades together.
exercises.formTip: Keep shoulders down, away from ears.

exercises.name: Overhead Press (Light Dumbbell)
exercises.cue: Press weights overhead from shoulder height, then lower with control.
exercises.formTip: Avoid arching the lower back — keep ribs down.

exercises.name: Wall Angels
exercises.cue: Back against wall, arms in a goalpost shape, slide arms up and down along the wall.
exercises.formTip: Keep lower back gently pressed to the wall.

exercises.name: Cat-Cow
exercises.cue: On all fours, alternate arching and rounding the spine slowly with the breath.
exercises.formTip: Move slowly — sync the movement to inhale/exhale.

exercises.name: Hip Circles
exercises.cue: Standing, hands on hips, draw slow circles with the hips in each direction.
exercises.formTip: Keep knees soft, don't lock them.

exercises.name: Thread the Needle
exercises.cue: On all fours, thread one arm under the body, rotating through the upper back.
exercises.formTip: Keep hips square, let the rotation come from the upper back.

exercises.name: Plank Hold
exercises.cue: Forearms and toes on the ground, body in a straight line.
exercises.formTip: Squeeze glutes and brace core to avoid sagging hips.

exercises.name: Modified Plank (Knees)
exercises.cue: Forearms on ground, knees down, body straight from head to knees.
exercises.formTip: Keep hips level, don't let lower back sag.

exercises.name: Sit to Stand
exercises.cue: From seated, stand up without using hands, then lower back down with control.
exercises.formTip: Lead with the chest, keep weight through the heels.

exercises.name: Reverse Lunge
exercises.cue: Step one foot back, lower until both knees are near 90°, push back to standing.
exercises.formTip: Keep front knee tracking over the ankle, torso upright.

exercises.name: Standing Balance Hold
exercises.cue: Stand on one leg, hands on hips or holding a chair for support.
exercises.formTip: Fix eyes on a point ahead to help with balance.

exercises.name: Superman Hold
exercises.cue: Lying face down, lift arms and legs slightly off the floor, hold briefly.
exercises.formTip: Keep the lift small and controlled — this isn't about height.

exercises.name: Standing Deep Breathing with Pelvic Floor Engagement
exercises.cue: Inhale to relax the pelvic floor, exhale while gently engaging and lifting.
exercises.formTip: Keep breathing slow and even, avoid holding tension after the exhale.
